rules: Original combat poses are rendering and anatomy masters.
No code rotation, no global blur, no hero or node scaling to fake reach.
Pose angle alone cannot change body motion.
Impact/contact markers in preview are guides, not authored effects.

phases.name: windup
phases.body: Torso turns away, weight on rear leg, both hands near rear shoulder.

phases.name: contact
phases.body: Torso rotates toward trunk, weight transfers forward, axe edge at trunk side48px above ground.

phases.name: recovery
phases.body: Side lunge with connected two-hand grip; existing g7 is gesture reference only.

axe.limitation: Authored key-pose proofs; complete interchangeable layers, semantic palette masks, smooth in-betweens and production registration remain outstanding.
axe.nodeContext: Old small-tree draft only; replace with current mature-trunk context and recheck contact before final acceptance.

sickle.direction: low lateral sweep across plant stems

phases.name: reach

phases.name: contact
phases.body: Low lateral pull with crescent edge crossing stem base, not overhead/downstroke.

phases.name: pullback
phases.body: Weight transfers sideways while hand stays below waist; g6 only posture reference.
